    toc: true

params:
  con: NULL
  owner: NULL
  tables: NULL
  unit: "GB"
  show_privileges: true

```{css ora-report-css, echo = FALSE}
h2 {
  border-top: 1px solid #c3c2b7
}
h2 {
  padding-top: 24px
}
h2 {
  margin-top: 40px
}
```

```{r ora-report-setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4
)
con <- params$con
unit <- params$unit
owners <- params$owner
tables <- params$tables
if (is.null(tables)) {
  tables <- data.frame(owner = character(0), table_name = character(0))
}

# Escape $ so pandoc does not read V$VIEW names as math.
esc <- function(x) {
  gsub("$", "\\$", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Run one query: errors become a "Skipped" note, ALL_* fallbacks a
# "Partial" note. Returns NULL when skipped.
run <- function(expr) {
  partial <- FALSE
  res <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      expr,
      ora_partial = function(m) {
        partial <<- TRUE
        invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(res, "error")) {
    cat("\n> Skipped: ", esc(conditionMessage(res)), "\n\n", sep = "")
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (partial) {
    cat(
      "\n> Partial result: some DBA_* views are not readable,",
      "ALL_* views were used.\n\n"
    )
  }
  res
}

# Print a data.frame as a table, at most n rows.
tab <- function(x, n = 20L, caption = NULL) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(caption)) {
      cat("\n", esc(caption), ": no rows.\n\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("\nNo rows.\n\n")
    }
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (col in names(x)) {
    if (is.character(x[[col]])) {
      x[[col]] <- esc(x[[col]])
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(caption)) {
    caption <- esc(caption)
  }
  print(knitr::kable(x[seq_len(min(n, nrow(x))), , drop = FALSE],
    row.names = FALSE, caption = caption))
  if (nrow(x) > n) {
    cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d rows shown.\n", n, nrow(x)))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Print a markdown heading on its own lines, also right after a plot.
heading <- function(level, text) {
  cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", text, "\n\n", sep = "")
}

# Turn the one-row fullness result into measure / value / meaning rows.
fullness_rows <- function(x) {
  unit_label <- if (unit == "B") "bytes" else unit
  suffix <- if (unit == "B") "bytes" else tolower(unit)
  meaning <- c(
    used = "space the segments occupy",
    allocated = "current size of the data files on disk",
    max = "size the data files can grow to with autoextend",
    free = "max minus used, room left before the database is full"
  )
  sizes <- vapply(names(meaning), function(m) {
    v <- x[[paste(m, suffix, sep = "_")]]
    paste(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = if (unit == "B") 0L else 2L,
      big.mark = ","), unit_label)
  }, character(1L))
  data.frame(
    measure = c(names(meaning), "used_pct"),
    value = c(unname(sizes), sprintf("%.2f %%", x$used_pct)),
    meaning = c(unname(meaning), "used as a share of max")
  )
}

has_rows <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0L
}

need_owner <- function() {
  if (length(owners) == 0L) {
    cat("\nSet `owner` to show this section.\n\n")
    return(FALSE)
  }
  TRUE
}

sql_block <- function(sql) {
  cat("\n```sql\n")
  cat(as.character(sql), sep = "\n")
  cat("```\n\n")
}
```

```{r ora-report-header, results = "asis"}
v <- run(ora::ora_version(con))
if (has_rows(v)) {
  cat(sprintf("Database: %s, version %s.\n\n", v$product, v$version_full))
}
me <- run(ora::ora_whoami(con))
if (!is.null(me)) {
  cat(sprintf("Connected as %s (container %s).\n\n", me$username,
    me$container))
}
cat(sprintf("Sizes in %s.", unit))
if (length(owners) > 0L) {
  cat(sprintf(" Schemas in detail: %s.", paste(owners, collapse = ", ")))
}
cat("\n\n")
```

```{r ora-report-privileges, eval = params$show_privileges, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Privileges")
if (!is.null(me)) {
  cat(sprintf("Session roles: %s.\n\n",
    if (length(me$roles) > 0L) paste(me$roles, collapse = ", ") else "none"))
}
views <- c(
  "DBA_SEGMENTS", "DBA_TABLESPACE_USAGE_METRICS", "DBA_DATA_FILES",
  "DBA_USERS", "DBA_OBJECTS", "DBA_INDEXES", "DBA_LOBS", "DBA_INDEX_USAGE",
  "V$INSTANCE", "V$SESSION", "V$SEGMENT_STATISTICS", "V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST"
)
readable <- run(ora::ora_can_read(con, views))
if (!is.null(readable)) {
  tab(data.frame(view = names(readable), readable = unname(readable)))
}
```

```{r ora-report-fullness, eval = params$show_fullness, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Database fullness")
full <- run(ora::ora_db_fullness(con, unit))
if (has_rows(full)) {
  tab(fullness_rows(full),
    caption = "Whole database, permanent and undo tablespaces without temp")
}
ts <- run(ora::ora_tablespace_usage(con, unit))
tab(ts, caption = "Per tablespace, fullest first, without temp")
if (has_rows(ts)) {
  ora::ora_plot_tablespaces(ts)
}
heading(3, "Temporary tablespaces")
tab(run(ora::ora_temp_usage(con, unit)), caption = "Temporary tablespaces")
heading(3, "Fast recovery area")
tab(run(ora::ora_fra_usage(con, unit)), caption = "Fast recovery area")
```

```{r ora-report-schemas, eval = params$show_schemas, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Schemas")
sc <- run(ora::ora_schema_sizes(con, unit))
tab(sc)
if (has_rows(sc)) {
  ora::ora_plot_schemas(sc)
}
for (o in owners) {
  heading(3, sprintf("%s by segment type", o))
  tab(run(ora::ora_schema_breakdown(con, o, unit)))
}
```

```{r ora-report-segments, eval = params$show_segments, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Biggest segments")
tab(run(ora::ora_top_segments(con, n = 20L, unit = unit)))
for (o in owners) {
  heading(3, sprintf("Tables of %s", o))
  cat("Data, indexes and LOBs per table. IOT data counts as data.\n\n")
  tb <- run(ora::ora_table_sizes(con, o, unit))
  tab(tb)
  if (has_rows(tb)) {
    ora::ora_plot_table_sizes(tb)
  }
  heading(3, sprintf("Indexes of %s", o))
  tab(run(ora::ora_index_sizes(con, o, unit)), n = 10L)
  heading(3, sprintf("LOBs of %s", o))
  tab(run(ora::ora_lob_sizes(con, o, unit)), n = 10L)
  heading(3, sprintf("Recycle bin of %s", o))
  tab(run(ora::ora_recyclebin_size(con, o, unit)))
}
```

```{r ora-report-iot, eval = params$show_iot, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Index-organized tables")
cat("`ALTER INDEX ... REBUILD` fails on IOT top indexes, use",
  "`ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION` or `SHRINK SPACE`.\n\n")
if (need_owner()) {
  for (o in owners) {
    heading(3, sprintf("%s", o))
    tab(run(ora::ora_iot_tables(con, o, unit)))
  }
}
```

```{r ora-report-partitions, eval = params$show_partitions, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Partitions")
if (nrow(tables) == 0L) {
  cat("\nSet `tables` to show this section.\n\n")
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(tables))) {
  o <- tables$owner[i]
  t <- tables$table_name[i]
  heading(3, sprintf("%s.%s", o, t))
  tab(run(ora::ora_partition_summary(con, o, t, unit)))
  b <- run(ora::ora_partition_bounds(con, o, t, unit))
  if (has_rows(b)) {
    ora::ora_plot_partitions(b, main = sprintf("Size per partition of %s", t))
    cat("\n\nOldest partitions:\n\n")
    tab(b[, setdiff(names(b), "high_value")], n = 10L)
  }
  cat("Estimated versus actual size, most reclaimable first.",
    "Shrink cannot go below the first extent (`initial`).\n\n")
  est <- run(ora::ora_partition_estimates(con, o, t, unit))
  if (has_rows(est)) {
    rec_col <- grep("^reclaimable_", names(est), value = TRUE)[1L]
    est <- est[!is.na(est[[rec_col]]), ]
    if (nrow(est) == 0L) {
      cat("\nNo partition statistics, waste cannot be estimated.\n\n")
    } else {
      if (!all(est$reliable)) {
        cat("\n> Statistics are locked or stale for some partitions,",
          "estimates may be wrong.\n\n")
      }
      keep <- c("partition_name", "num_rows",
        grep("^(estimated|segment|initial|reclaimable)_(bytes|kb|mb|gb|tb)$",
          names(est), value = TRUE),
        "reliable")
      tab(est[order(-est[[rec_col]]), keep], n = 10L)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r ora-report-activity, eval = params$show_activity, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Activity")
cat("Statistics count from instance startup.\n\n")
tab(run(ora::ora_instance_uptime(con)))
if (need_owner()) {
  for (o in owners) {
    heading(3, sprintf("Untouched tables of %s", o))
    tab(run(ora::ora_untouched_tables(con, o, unit)))
    heading(3, sprintf("Unused indexes of %s", o))
    tab(run(ora::ora_unused_indexes(con, o, unit)))
  }
}
```

```{r ora-report-cleanup, eval = params$show_cleanup, results = "asis"}
heading(2, "Cleanup SQL")
cat("Generated only, nothing was run. Review it and run it with",
  "`ora_run_sql(con, sql, confirm = TRUE)`.\n\n")
if (need_owner()) {
  for (o in owners) {
    heading(3, sprintf("Unusable indexes of %s", o))
    ui <- run(ora::ora_unusable_indexes(con, o))
    tab(ui)
    if (has_rows(ui)) {
      for (ix in unique(ui$index_name)) {
        parts <- ui$partition_name[ui$index_name == ix &
          ui$object_level == "PARTITION"]
        if (length(parts) == 0L) {
          parts <- NULL
        }
        sql <- run(ora::ora_sql_rebuild_index(con, o, ix, parts))
        if (!is.null(sql)) {
          sql_block(sql)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(tables))) {
  o <- tables$owner[i]
  t <- tables$table_name[i]
  heading(3, sprintf("Shrink %s.%s", o, t))
  est <- run(ora::ora_partition_estimates(con, o, t, "B"))
  if (has_rows(est)) {
    stats <- est[!is.na(est$reclaimable_bytes), ]
    gain <- stats[stats$reclaimable_bytes > 0, ]
    if (nrow(stats) == 0L) {
      cat("\nNo partition statistics, no shrink suggested.\n\n")
    } else if (nrow(gain) == 0L) {
      cat("\nAll partitions are at or near their minimum size, shrinking",
        "frees nothing. Only dropping partitions frees space.\n\n")
    } else {
      if (!all(gain$reliable)) {
        cat("\n> Statistics are locked or stale, check the estimates",
          "before shrinking.\n\n")
      }
      gain <- gain[order(-gain$reclaimable_bytes), ]
      top <- utils::head(gain, 3L)
      cat(sprintf(
        "\nThe %d partitions with the most reclaimable space, at most %s.\n\n",
        nrow(top),
        ora:::ora_fmt_size(ora:::ora_bytes_to_unit(
          sum(top$reclaimable_bytes), unit), unit)
      ))
      sql <- run(ora::ora_sql_shrink_partitions(con, o, t, top$partition_name))
      if (!is.null(sql)) {
        sql_block(sql)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
